title: Review Tolerance by Supply Tenure - C&I Credit Standard
content:
## Anniversary security review: tolerance by supply tenure (Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts)

The review tolerance is a share of the review requirement deducted from the shortfall before rounding, set by the contract's supply tenure, the whole months from the service start date to the handling date: 36 months or more give 0.10, 12 months up to 35 months give 0.05, and a shorter tenure gives no tolerance.

The shortfall is the review requirement less the security deposits held on the contract. The tolerance is deducted from it before the amount is rounded to the cent; when the tolerance equals or exceeds the shortfall, nothing is requested. Whole months are calendar months from the service start date, a month being complete on the same day of the month as the service start date.

| Supply tenure | Tolerance, as a share of the review requirement |
|---|---|
| 36 whole months or more | 0.10 |
| 12 to 35 whole months | 0.05 |
| 11 whole months or fewer | none |

## Cases (hypothetical, review requirement $58500.00)

| Deposits held | Supply tenure | Tolerance | Amount requested |
|---|---|---|---|
| $40000.00 | 40 months | 5850.00 | 18500.00 less 5850.00: $12650.00 |
| $40000.00 | 20 months | 2925.00 | 18500.00 less 2925.00: $15575.00 |
| $40000.00 | 8 months | none | $18500.00 |
| $55000.00 | 40 months | 5850.00, more than the 3500.00 shortfall | nothing |
